vectors.name: dr-1-boot-clean
vectors.expected: BootReport::Started; advisories empty; log_unreachable=false; gate_signer_key present
vectors.description: Valid manifest + valid carrier; translog reachable with no applicable advisory (empty log); no disable entry. Expected: clean Started. Composes GV-1..GV-10/14/15/16a (manifest) + GV-20..GV-28 (carrier) + TL-20 (anchored STH accepted, empty log = no advisory).

vectors.name: dr-2-refuse-on-bad-manifest-log-never-consulted
vectors.expected: BootReport::RefuseToStart{stage: Manifest, reason}; a consult that demonstrably surfaces an advisory on the success path surfaces NOTHING here (TL-19, behavioral-contrast observable)
vectors.description: Self-contained TL-19 observable. The same byte-identical live translog handle (a GV-13 Class-A revocation of the manifest's image-signing signer, identical construction to DR-3) is booted twice. (1) Positive control: VALID manifest -> Started with a Gv13Revocation advisory, proving the log is live (a consult observably surfaces an advisory). (2) Refuse: ONE Ed25519 signature byte flipped (GV-1) -> RefuseToStart{stage: Manifest}; the advisory is produced nowhere. The only differing input is the manifest signature byte, so advisory presence (control) vs absence (refuse) is attributable solely to the manifest-verify outcome. This REPLACES the earlier entry-count proxy, which was vacuous (a read-only store's count is unchanged whether or not it was read). The call-skip is structurally guaranteed by the `?` short-circuit in verify_genesis_manifest_with_translog (manifest verify returns before the translog is matched); this vector proves the manifest-fail path does not surface what a consult would. Residual: a discarded read cannot be distinguished from a non-read at the daemon level; a direct call-observable would require instrumenting the shared TranslogStore (Architect-gated, not done). Composes GV-1 (tampered manifest) + GV-13 (live revocation entry) + TL-19 (manifest-verify-independent-of-log).
vectors.claims_note: TL-19 observable strengthened 2026-06-21 from a vacuous entry-count proxy to a behavioral contrast with an inline positive control. PARTIAL (SHIPPED-against-test-keys; cargo-backed). status_runner unchanged: NOT-EXECUTABLE-IN-RUNNER.

ADR_011 Section 3.2.3.1 item 5 ordering confirmed: read runs AFTER stages 1+2 (trust root), BEFORE stage 5 (disable consult). rollback_residual_note: A host-root in-place rollback of the state file to a prior validly-sealed record is undetectable in Phase-0 (dr_state_rollback #[ignore] in synoi-genesis persistence_dr_tests; ADR_011 Section 3.2.3.1 item 3). A rolled-back state is operationally authoritative until the first successful live refresh re-raises the HWM/LKG/epoch. Full anti-rollback requires a hardware monotonic counter (TPM/secure-element, Section 7) OR a witnessed transparency-log anchor (ADR_012 Section 4, project_translog_witnessing_transition). Neither exists in Phase-0. The boot() wiring DOES NOT claim to close rollback. The #[ignore] companion in synoi-genesis documents the honest limit as a paired negative vector.
